# Changelog: Shared shopping lists

## 0.21.0

- Add what you bought to Shared expenses: with the two apps connected, the ticked items with a price become an expense paid by you, split equally between everyone on the list. Adding the same list twice changes nothing.

## 0.20.0

- Calendar: click a day in the week, month or year view to list its shopping lists below; click it again, or change the view, to see everything in the period. The month name in the year view still opens that month.

## 0.19.0

- Store logos: when a store is added, its logo is looked up (Wikidata and Wikimedia Commons, or the store's website) and shown next to the store's name on the list. Stores you already have get theirs too.

## 0.18.0

- Search for nearby stores is more reliable: when OpenStreetMap's main server is busy, two others are asked, and when few shops are close by, a wider area (6 km) is searched.
- Not sharing your location, or it cannot be found? Type a town or address and search there instead.
- Clearer messages when the location is blocked, including where to allow it on an iPhone.

## 0.17.0

- Filter events from connected apps by month or by a selected day in the Calendar tab.

## 0.16.0

- **Search for nearby stores**: share your location once and pick from the shops within 2 km (from OpenStreetMap), all ticked; the ones you keep are added to the list. Your location is not saved.
- Clearing bought products and removing a store now ask in the app’s own window.

## 0.15.0

- A card suggests the family planner where it helps (until you connect it or close the card).

## 0.14.1

- When a member removes their DevQuake account, what they added to your things (comments, items, ticks, photos…) stays, shown as “REMOVED_…” instead of their name.

## 0.14.0

- Pictures load faster: lists and previews show small versions, and tapping a picture opens it in full size.
- “Back” links now return to the page you came from, with its filters and where you had scrolled to.

## 0.13.0

- The app’s card on DevQuake and its front page now show how many members use it and its totals: shopping lists, items.

0.12.0

- Calendars across apps: under the calendar, “From your other apps” lists the next 31 days of the apps you connected — family events (shared ones included), training sessions and bill due dates — each opening in its app.
- Works with the family planner, the workout tracker and the utility bill manager; the family planner and the others can show your shopping days (list names and dates only).
- “Works with” now has “Disconnect” for a connected app: the two stop working together, your subscriptions and everything you made stay. Connecting again is free.

## 0.11.0

- Works with the family planner: once you connect the two on DevQuake, your open lists show on the family’s Today page, the family can add items to them, and a tap opens the list here with a way back. “Works with” at the bottom of the page lists the apps that fit together.

## 0.10.1

- People who do not use the app yet now see what it does on its front page, with a link to the user manual, and shared links show the app’s own picture.

## 0.10.0

- Add the app to your home screen: on phones and tablets, the new button in the toolbar puts the app’s icon (its logo with the DevQuake badge) on your home screen, so it opens like an app.

## 0.9.0

- While shopping, **Correct price** saves the price on the shelf; the planned price is kept next to it.
- New in Statistics: **Prices over time**, how the prices of your products change and how close your planned prices were.
- Copy lists to other days: one list to a day, a week or a month, a whole week to the rest of the month, or a whole month to the rest of the year.
- In shopping mode, adding a product is folded away at the top, so the list comes first.
- Notifications: **Clear all**, or remove them one by one; the list always fits the screen.
- A tidier toolbar on every screen: the app’s name (tap it for the start page), full screen and the DevQuake mark. The manual and version notes moved to the bottom of the page; your language and theme are set in your DevQuake account.

## 0.8.0

- A full screen button in the toolbar, where your browser allows it (not on iPhone).

## 0.7.0

- The app's logo is shown next to its name in the toolbar and as the browser tab icon.
- New to the app? You can try it free for 24 hours before subscribing.

## 0.6.0

- The app is now available in German, Romanian and Hungarian as well as English. Pick a
  language with the globe in the toolbar. DevQuake remembers your choice. On your first visit
  it uses your browser's language if it is one of these, and English otherwise.
- Everything is translated: the screens, the user manual, notifications and error messages.
  Dates, weekdays and prices are written the way your language writes them.
- Each language has its own address (for example /de/help), so search engines can show the
  manual in your language.

## 0.5.1

- The buttons on the Today screen stay readable when you point at them in the dark theme.
- The user manual now explains who can see your lists: only you and the people on each list.

## 0.5.0

- The owner of a list can delete it from **Share & settings**. It disappears for everyone on
  it, with its invite links, notifications and product photos.
- Your statistics stay the same after a list is deleted: what was planned and bought on it
  still counts for everyone who was on it.
- If a list is deleted while you have it open, you see a short message and a link back to
  your lists.

## 0.4.1

- The user manual can be read without an account, so you can see how the app works before
  signing up. It is also linked from the app's card on DevQuake.

## 0.4.0

- **Not needed**: strike out a product that is no longer needed. If it was already bought, it
  stays in the list with a darker background and a 🙃, and statistics show the money spent on
  things that were not needed.
- **Notifications** inside the app: a bell with what your friends did on shared lists, pop-ups
  for new changes and, if you allow it, system notifications while the app is open in a
  background tab.
- The app's version is shown in the toolbar and footer; click it to see what changed.

## 0.3.0

- Product photos: add one when creating or editing a product. Photos are made smaller on your
  device before uploading, and only people on the list can see them.
- Suggestions from your own shopping: the product field suggests what you bought before (accents
  do not matter) and can fill in the whole row: unit, quantity, last price, description, store
  and photo.
- "Usual products": one tap adds a frequently bought product with everything from last time.
- The home screen (Today, Calendar, Statistics) now updates by itself when anything changes on
  your lists, like open lists already did.

## 0.2.0

- Every list has a shopping date (date picker, today by default).
- Home screen with swipeable tabs: **Today** (today's lists with products, prices and totals per
  store), **Calendar** (week, month and year views of all lists), **New list** (create or join)
  and **Statistics** (totals per currency, stores, spending per month, most bought products with
  price history, and how often each friend joined your lists).
- Products need a name and a unit; the quantity is optional (counts as 1).
- A user manual, opened from **Manual** in the toolbar.

## 0.1.0

- Shared shopping lists with members, invitations, stores and products.
- Lists with a currency; products with quantity, unit, price per unit and description; totals
  per store, "still to buy" and the whole list; shopping mode; clearing bought products.
- Stores with name, type, location and description; store types from a catalogue (food,
  home improvement, electronics, apparel, health and beauty), filled in automatically for
  well-known chains.
- Sharing by invite link, code or QR code (which you can renew), and by adding friends you
  invited to DevQuake with one tap.
- Changes by others appear on an open list within a few seconds.
- Your lists are handed over or removed properly when you delete your DevQuake account.
